proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E F G _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ S T R c
  refine ⟨map_add _ S T, ?_, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_comp R T, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_adjoint T⟩
  exact map_smulₛₗ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (𝕜 := 𝕜) (E := E) (F := F)) c T
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E F G : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace F] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 G] [CompleteSpace G] (S T : E →L[𝕜] F) (R : F →L[𝕜] G) (c : 𝕜), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (S + T) = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint S + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ∧ ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (c • T) = (starRingEnd 𝕜) c • ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T ∧ ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (R.comp T) = (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint R) ∧ ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) = T
